name: help
stdout:
usage: install_user_runtime_agents.py [-h] --claude-home CLAUDE_HOME
                                      --codex-home CODEX_HOME [--apply]

Install reviewed Yoke agents and Claude commands into explicit user homes.
This is deliberately separate from plugin activation. It reads only the
checked-in capability allowlists, never infers a home directory, and writes
only with --apply.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --claude-home CLAUDE_HOME
  --codex-home CODEX_HOME
  --apply               perform the otherwise dry-run sync
